evidence.limitations: Campaign totals are operator-record claims, not independently verified. Some exploit attempts failed. An “autonomous” framework label does not override observed approval evidence. Formal group-alliance confidence is low; complete-log claims cannot establish unseen activity was absent.
evidence.open_questions: Generalization outside inspected settings and completeness/authenticity of underlying traces remain unestablished by the Commons.
evidence.support_assessment: Attributed bounded finding; publication inclusion does not certify truth or completeness. One exposed infrastructure investigation supports the campaign grouping; individual victims are not collapsed into one independently verified event. Raw leaked material not accessed or copied. No matching source or underlying case found among baseline v0.4.1 SRC-001–018 / CASE-001–017; recurring report mentions merge into this candidate, not corroboration.

terms.name: Chaperoning
terms.definition: The continuing supervisory activity of independently observing consequential behavior, exercising informed judgment, and intervening effectively when appropriate. This requires access, competence, authority, and an actual ability to alter outcomes—not nominal participation or an agent merely stating that an action is inappropriate.

terms.name: Constraint compression
terms.definition: A reduction, often AI-enabled, in the practical barriers of knowledge, expertise, labor, cost, time, or coordination that once limited an activity. It describes the change in constraints, not the eventual impact of the activity.

terms.name: Investigative indicator
terms.definition: An observed characteristic or combination of signals that provides a reason to investigate a possible event, mechanism, or hidden relationship without establishing that it occurred.
